scripts.build: wp-scripts build settings=./src/settings/index.js notice=./src/notice.js media=./src/media/index.js media-grid=./src/media/grid.js bulk=./src/bulk/index.js folders=./src/folders/index.js --output-path=assets/build
scripts.start: wp-scripts start settings=./src/settings/index.js notice=./src/notice.js media=./src/media/index.js media-grid=./src/media/grid.js bulk=./src/bulk/index.js folders=./src/folders/index.js --output-path=assets/build
scripts.test:integration:multisite: wp-env --config=.wp-env.test.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/iminify-image-optimizer env WP_MULTISITE=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.integration.xml.dist
